name: Planning
description: Simple shift planning per channel: an admin enables it and creates shifts, members take them, the admin locks them. English, French, German, Italian. By ShiftPlugins (Smafe, Switzerland).

settings_schema.header: Shift planning per channel. A channel admin enables it with the calendar icon or `/planning enable`. The plugin follows each user's Mattermost language (English, French, German, Italian); bot messages in channels use the server's default language.

settings.help_text: The bot posts a message when someone takes or releases a shift.
Members can offer their shift to a colleague.
If on, a channel admin must approve each swap. Otherwise the swap happens straight away.
